recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Further work should only be opened as a separate decision if the work group wants structured CapabilityStatement documentation of lastUpdated guarantees; duplicating the existing core guidance is not needed for FHIR-44106.
issue_request: FHIR-44106 was an Applied FHIR-core search issue, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking whether Meta.lastUpdated and _lastUpdated should explicitly allow false positives and false negatives for facade servers or whether a new flexible mechanism was needed. Its final resolution points to the FHIR-45012 disposition.
initial_application: FHIR-45012 was applied in core by 8d7041c700, which added lastUpdated caveat text to source/datatypes/meta.xml. FHIR-44106 was then applied by 3d13acd274, PR 3442, which added the same caveat to source/search.html. FHIR-45047 later refined the Meta.lastUpdated comments in 993291c03c.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes confirm the FHIR-44106 Persuasive with Modification vote, and the related Zulip discussion shows the work group direction was to clarify lastUpdated expectations rather than create a proposed last-underlying-data-update extension. FHIR-45047 is already represented on the combined branch, so it was not duplicated here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/search.html already warns that returned data can change without lastUpdated changing and that lastUpdated can change without apparent data changes; source/datatypes/meta.xml already gives broader facade-server Meta.lastUpdated guidance, including mapping-table and generated-resource examples and a preference for too-frequent updates over missed updates.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-44106's resolution points to this issue, whose disposition rejected the proposed extension in favor of clarifying Meta.lastUpdated.
This later Applied issue refined the Meta.lastUpdated comment and is already represented on the combined branch.
